    'RPL_THEME4': 'Housing & Transportation',
}
SDOH_2023 = ['FOODINSECU', 'HOUSINSECU', 'LACKTRPT', 'LONELINESS']
SDOH_2023_LABELS = {
    'FOODINSECU': 'Food Insecurity', 'HOUSINSECU': 'Housing Insecurity',

sns.set_theme\(style='whitegrid', font_scale=1.05\)
PALETTE_5YR = sns.color_palette\('tab10', len\(SDOH_5YR\)\)
COLOR_2019 = '#4878CF'
COLOR_2023 = '#D65F5F'
print\('Setup OK'\)

# fig1
records = []
for data_yr, yr_grp in df.groupby\('data_year'\):
    for target in TARGETS:
        for factor in SDOH_5YR:
            valid = yr_grp[[factor, target]].dropna\(\)
            if len\(valid\) < 30: continue
            r, p = pearsonr\(valid[factor], valid[target]\)
            records.append\({'data_year': data_yr, 'target': target, 'factor': factor, 'r': round\(r,4\), 'p_value': round\(p,6\), 'n': len\(valid\)}\)
corr_trend = pd.DataFrame\(records\)
print\(f'Trend records: {len\(corr_trend\)}'\)

        fdata = sub[sub['factor'] == factor].sort_values\('data_year'\)
        ax.plot\(fdata['data_year'], fdata['r'], marker='o', linewidth=2.2, markersize=7, color=PALETTE_5YR[i], label=SDOH_LABELS[factor]\)
    ax.set_title\(TARGET_LABELS[target]\)
    ax.set_xticks\(sorted\(df['data_year'].unique\(\)\)\)
    ax.legend\(bbox_to_anchor=\(1.01,1\), loc='upper left', fontsize=9\)
plt.tight_layout\(\)
plt.savefig\('processed_data/fig1_sdoh_trend.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight'\)
plt.close\(\)
print\('fig1 OK'\)

# fig2
endpoints = corr_trend[corr_trend['data_year'].isin\([2019, 2023]\)].copy\(\)
x = np.arange\(len\(SDOH_5YR\)\)
width = 0.35

for ax, target in zip\(axes, TARGETS\):
    sub = endpoints[endpoints['target'] == target]
    def get_r\(year, factor, sub=sub\):
        row = sub[\(sub['data_year'] == year\) & \(sub['factor'] == factor\)]
        return row['r'].values[0] if len\(row\) else np.nan
    r_2019 = [get_r\(2019, f\) for f in SDOH_5YR]
    r_2023 = [get_r\(2023, f\) for f in SDOH_5YR]
    bars_a = ax.bar\(x - width/2, r_2019, width, label='2019', color=COLOR_2019, alpha=0.85\)
    bars_b = ax.bar\(x + width/2, r_2023, width, label='2023', color=COLOR_2023, alpha=0.85\)
    for bar in list\(bars_a\) + list\(bars_b\):
        h = bar.get_height\(\)
        if not np.isnan\(h\):
            ax.text\(bar.get_x\(\) + bar.get_width\(\)/2, h + 0.008, f'{h:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8\)
    for i, \(v19, v23\) in enumerate\(zip\(r_2019, r_2023\)\):
        if not \(np.isnan\(v19\) or np.isnan\(v23\)\):
            color_arrow = '#2ca02c' if v23 > v19 else '#9467bd'
            ax.annotate\('', xy=\(x[i]+width/2, v23+0.04\), xytext=\(x[i]-width/2, v19+0.04\), arrowprops=dict\(arrowstyle='->', color=color_arrow, lw=1.2\)\)
    ax.set_xticks\(x\)
    ax.set_xticklabels\([SDOH_LABELS[f] for f in SDOH_5YR], rotation=30, ha='right'\)
    ax.set_ylim\(0, 1.1\)
    ax.legend\(\)
plt.tight_layout\(\)
plt.savefig\('processed_data/fig2_2019_vs_2023.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight'\)
plt.close\(\)
print\('fig2 OK'\)

# fig3
heatmap_factors = SDOH_5YR + SVI_FACTORS + SDOH_2023
heat_records = {}
for target in TARGETS:
    row = {}
    for factor in heatmap_factors:
        valid = df_2023[[factor, target]].dropna\(\)
        if len\(valid\) >= 30:
            r, _ = pearsonr\(valid[factor], valid[target]\)
            row[all_factor_labels.get\(factor, factor\)] = round\(r, 3\)
        else:
            row[all_factor_labels.get\(factor, factor\)] = np.nan
    heat_records[TARGET_LABELS[target]] = row
heat_df = pd.DataFrame\(heat_records\).T
fig, ax = plt.subplots\(figsize=\(16, 3.5\)\)
sns.heatmap\(heat_df, annot=True, fmt='.2f', annot_kws={'size':9}, cmap='RdYlGn', center=0, vmin=-0.5, vmax=1.0, linewidths=0.6, linecolor='white', cbar_kws={'label':'Pearson r','shrink':0.7}, ax=ax\)
ax.set_xticklabels\(ax.get_xticklabels\(\), rotation=40, ha='right', fontsize=9\)
ax.set_yticklabels\(ax.get_yticklabels\(\), rotation=0\)
plt.tight_layout\(\)
plt.savefig\('processed_data/fig3_heatmap_2023.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight'\)
plt.close\(\)
print\('fig3 OK'\)

# fig4
all_factors = SDOH_5YR + SVI_FACTORS + SDOH_2023
corr_2023_records = []
for target in TARGETS:
    for factor in all_factors:
        valid = df_2023[[factor, target]].dropna\(\)
        if len\(valid\) < 30: continue
        r, p = pearsonr\(valid[factor], valid[target]\)
        corr_2023_records.append\({'factor_label': all_factor_labels.get\(factor, factor\), 'target': TARGET_LABELS[target], 'r': round\(r,3\)}\)
corr_2023_df = pd.DataFrame\(corr_2023_records\)
fig, axes = plt.subplots\(1, 2, figsize=\(16, 7\)\)
for ax, target_label in zip\(axes, [TARGET_LABELS[t] for t in TARGETS]\):
    sub = corr_2023_df[corr_2023_df['target'] == target_label].sort_values\('r', ascending=True\)
    colors = ['#D65F5F' if r >= 0 else '#4878CF' for r in sub['r']]
    bars = ax.barh\(sub['factor_label'], sub['r'], color=colors, alpha=0.85, edgecolor='white', height=0.6\)
    for bar, val in zip\(bars, sub['r']\):
        offset = 0.012 if val >= 0 else -0.012
        ha = 'left' if val >= 0 else 'right'
        ax.text\(val + offset, bar.get_y\(\) + bar.get_height\(\)/2, f'{val:.2f}', va='center', ha=ha, fontsize=8.5\)
    ax.axvline\(0, color='black', linewidth=0.8, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6\)
    ax.set_title\(target_label\)
    ax.set_xlim\(-0.7, 1.1\)
plt.tight_layout\(\)
plt.savefig\('processed_data/fig4_top_correlates_2023.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight'\)
